text: Completed task_2026-09-04_011 (Gate 3 research, child of task_2026-09-04_006), read-only clone, no edits/commits/push. Submitted full decision brief for items 1-5 via checkpoint (item 6 skipped per spec). Key findings: (1) cli.py::build_parser() confirmed flat argparse, 10 flags, no subcommands — WK4 dev-log's `audit`/`--backend`/`--bca-bootstrap` claims unsupported; --bca-bootstrap would be small-moderate effort (bootstrap fn already accepts n_resamples param), --backend is non-trivial and conflicts with the locked dual-backend-by-design architecture, audit subcommand is a moderate argparse restructure. WP3 PDF-export claim (README:60) also unsupported — zero PDF deps/code. (2) 10,954/97,698=11.2%; 10,954 is the FULL val split (86,744 train + 10,954 val = 97,698, per CLAIM_LEDGER R-002) so this isn't a partial-run shortfall — README already correctly frames it as 10,954/10,954; the "90%" is workstream completion, a separate axis from dataset coverage. Separately, project's own CLAIM_LEDGER "VALIDATED" tier requires a full 97,698-image run, which hasn't happened. (3) Directly viewed architecture_highlevel.jpg — found 5 total stale elements, not the 2 that ledger Cluster C's own table names: YAML-config box and UTKFace-as-live box (Cluster C), SHAP-no-caveat box (filed under Cluster B, same image), plus TWO net-new ones this pass found nowhere in the existing ledger — a 108,501 FairFace figure (stale vs verified 97,698) and an "HTML/PDF" compliance-report box (stale vs PDF-unsupported finding) — neither previously catalogued against this specific image. (4) report/generator.py vs report/templates/generator.py are byte-identical except trailing newline; resolved which is dead: templates/generator.py has zero imports anywhere (also has no __init__.py, isn't even a package) — src/bias_aperture/report/generator.py is the live one (imported by report/__init__.py, cli.py, test_report_generator.py). Note: the task's own literal grep `import.*generator` (lowercase) returns zero hits for BOTH files since real imports use `HTMLReportGenerator` (capital G) — false-negative on the live file too if taken literally; needed case-insensitive re-check to resolve. This closes the "bonus, not scored" open question DISCREPANCY_LEDGER.md Section C had left unresolved. (5) Confirmed no .tex/.md/.docx/.odt source and no staging dir exists in-repo for the two fellowship PDFs (User_Requirement_Document, Literature_Review) — but pdfinfo shows both were authored in Microsoft Word 365 (not Google Docs/LibreOffice — checked raw byte signatures, zero hits), so a .docx source almost certainly existed outside the repo at authoring time; this is "no trackable in-repo source," not "no source ever existed." BiasAperture-AT.md §13 precedent (feasibility_study.pdf, an analogous already-submitted PDF-only gap): resolution pattern was to log gaps as Outstanding Action Item rows rather than hand-edit the PDF, and when the same content need existed in a doc with a live source (requirements.tex), fix it there while leaving the PDF-only doc explicitly, separately outstanding — never force-patched across 3+ tracked revisions. Open note for whoever picks up Gate-3-adjacent work: docs/BiasAperture-AT.md has a duplicate copy at "research/context feed/BiasAperture-AT.md" (flagged under Cluster A, unrelated to this task) — worth deduplicating at some point. Also worth noting for future sessions: this task heavily overlapped with prior task_2026-09-04_001's DISCREPANCY_LEDGER.md (items 1, 2, part of 3 were already covered there) — this pass added value mainly by firsthand-verifying rather than just citing, and by finding the 2 net-new stale image elements + resolving item 4's dead-code question outright.
